name: Hara Dhania Cholia
instructions: 1. Prepare a coarse paste using fresh coriander leaves, green chilies, and ginger-garlic.
2. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or kadhai until smoking hot, then reduce heat.
3. Add cumin seeds and sauté onions until golden brown.
4. Add tomatoes, turmeric, and coriander powder; cook until the oil separates.
5. Add the fresh green chickpeas and sauté for a few minutes.
6. Mix in the prepared coriander paste and salt, then add water to reach the desired consistency.
7. Cover and cook on low heat until the chickpeas are tender.
8. Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and serve hot with bajra roti or paratha.
description: Hara Dhania Cholia is a seasonal delicacy of Haryana, typically prepared during the winter months when fresh green chickpeas are harvested. It reflects the agrarian roots of the state, focusing on farm-fresh produce and simple yet bold, aromatic spices.
